description: Smart PaperDoll per-frame layer contract for EotB. No generated body or armor pixels are included yet.
mirrorPolicy: Reuse EotB spriteFor mirror result; mirror body and equipment layers together.

body.notes: One transparent PNG for every required source sprite key. Match the source frame canvas dimensions and anchor exactly.

cuirass.notes: Transparent overlay aligned to the corresponding body PNG; alpha must be zero outside the armor pixels.

fallback: Until body art and the compositor are implemented and validated, keep the original EotB sprite. Never substitute a different class-skin archive to simulate removing armor.
